title: Answer Context Filter Consumption QA
principle: Receipt-linked source filters must become visible source focus in Memory and Knowledge panels without storing raw prompts, raw responses, memory text, knowledge snippets or provider secrets.
public_repo_rule: Panels consume metadata-only receipt state from local dataset attributes and local highlight receipts. They render counts, IDs, source labels and state explanations, but do not persist private content in public artifacts.

scenarios.expected: Memory renders a visible receipt filter note when a selected answer carries memory source metadata.
Matching saved memory and last-message memory-use entries are marked as used in the selected answer when IDs match.
Knowledge shows an explicit receipt filter state and explains when exact document IDs are not available yet.
Filter consumption remains metadata-only and does not introduce provider keys, raw prompts, raw responses, memory text or knowledge snippets into public reports.
